options.autofish.title: Autofish Settings
options.autofish.basic.title: Basic Options
options.autofish.enable.title: Enable Autofish
options.autofish.enable.tooltip: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
options.autofish.multirod.title: Enable MultiRod
options.autofish.multirod.tooltip:
Cycles through all of the available rods
in the hotbar, moving to the next as
they break.
options.autofish.break_protection.title: Enable Break Protection
options.autofish.break_protection.toolti:
Stop using rods with low durability
before they break.
options.autofish.open_water_detection.to:
After 20w12a (1.16), you can only get
treasure loot in open water.
This will let you know when your hook
is not in open water.
options.autofish.persistent.title: Enable Persistent Mode
options.autofish.persistent.tooltip:
Keep the fish hook always in liquid
whenever a rod is in hand, recast when
needed. This is useful for lag issues or
when fishing for long periods of time.
options.autofish.unsafe_fluids.title: Consider Unsafe Fluids
options.autofish.unsafe_fluids.tooltip:
Also test fluids outside of known safe
ones for certain fishing rods, which may
force certain modded rods to work.
For example, this enables §clava§f fishing
for vanilla rods and its direct variants.
options.autofish.advanced.title: Advanced Options
options.autofish.sound.title: Use Sound Detection
options.autofish.sound.tooltip:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based on
bobber sounds rather than the standard
hook movement detection.§r
§f- You must be close to your hook.
- If other players' hooks are close by,
  it can falsely trigger a catch!
options.autofish.open_water_new_algorith:
§6New implementation more closely
following the documented open water
validation process on §eMinecraft Wiki§6.§r

§fTurn off to restore the relatively more
lenient legacy behavior.
options.autofish.noisy_detection.title: Keep Detection Notification
options.autofish.noisy_detection.tooltip:
§6Keep sending notification of detection
results to the player, regardless of
previous results. Affects the following:§r
§f- Open water detection
- Item rod test
options.autofish.legacy_persistence.tool:
§6Instead of using the newer state-aware
algorithm, switch back to the legacy
§ePersistent Mode§6 implementation.§r

§aNew§f: Gathers various states, counts time
durations, and reels accordingly.
§cOld§f: Tests every §e10§f seconds, and reels if
the hook isn't in fishable liquid in that
instant.
options.autofish.damage_safe_margin.tool:
Adjusts at least how much durability
should be left for rods to be safe.

Used by §eBreak Protection§f.
options.autofish.recast_delay.title: Recast Delay (ms)
options.autofish.recast_delay.tooltip_1: a fish and recasting the rod.

options.autofish.random_delay.tooltip_0: Add ±% randomness to the Recast Delay

options.autofish.reel_in_delay.title: Reel in delay
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.tooltip_0: Add a delay for the reel-in when a fish bites the float.
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.tooltip_1: Set this option to 1 to disable this function.

options.autofish.clear_regex.tooltip_1: this pattern is matched in chat.
